title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving nutrition and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) services in districts facing extremely critical acute malnutrition

description.narrative: This intervention will focus on underserved areas in Al Mokha and Mawza districts in Taiz, Hays and Al Khohka districts in Hodeidah, addressing gaps in Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) case management in priority locations and improving water and sanitation services for communities affected by malnutrition, and those vulnerable to waterborne diseases and the impact of climate change.The main aim of this project is to reduce mortality related to malnutrition in children under five with SAM with or without complications through the provision of lifesaving nutrition and WASH interventions. An estimated 68,800 children and women will benefit from nutrition services, implemented through health authorities and one implementing partner (FMF). In addition, 16,467 people in four communities in al Mokha district, Taiz, will further benefit from WASH activities to mitigate the risk of spread of water-borne disease; these include Al-Mashqar village, Al Kudaih village and Dar Al Shujah village as well as Al Mokha City where water sources will be rehabilitated/expanded/constructed.
